overview: This one-page file consists of a list-of-papers index for material filed under corporations in Formosa (Taiwan). It records a document from Warner at Taiboku concerning the Taiwan Development Company and its subsidiaries, reporting that plans for the economic development of South China were progressing although the organization remained at an initial stage.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning corporations in Formosa
subfiles.about: An index entry identifies a report from Warner at Taiboku on the activities and development plans of the Taiwan Development Company and its subsidiaries.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists one paper, dated November 5, from Warner at Taiboku. Its stated subject is the activity of the Taiwan Development Company and its subsidiaries, including plans for the economic development of South China. The enterprise was reportedly still in its initial organizational stage but making progress.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives here, it points to a potentially valuable report on the outward economic ambitions of a major Formosa-based development company. The reference to South China links colonial Taiwanese corporations to Japan’s broader regional expansion, while the note that organization was still preliminary may help date the evolution of those plans. The page is also useful for reconstructing a missing or separately filed report from Warner at Taiboku.
